decisions.reason: The button-styling Requirement is already explicitly scoped to the Admin Workspace by its same-message introduction; the shell naming change adds no new button-style value.
Renaming the shell as the Admin Workspace does not change the panel placement, collapsibility, or unresolved navigation arrangement.
This Requirement concerns the minimal shell for informational pages; the source renames the separate application UI shell and does not alter informational-page elements.
The Admin Workspace naming change does not alter any provisioning-wizard styling value, asset, layout variable, or scope.
The occurrence of name-related terminology in landing-page copy is incidental; the source does not change the landing-page structure or content sequence.
The source only names the application shell and discusses its buttons; it does not change landing-page responsive behavior.
The Admin Workspace naming change has no necessary effect on reusable responsive-breakpoint guidance.
The source does not address the shared website footer, its content, navigation links, or visual treatment.
Renaming the application shell does not change the theme selected for shared website pages.
The source does not change the requirement for a sign-up button on the landing page.
The shell naming change does not affect policy-document destinations, format, access point, or tab-opening behavior.
The source does not change the required webfont files, families, metadata, or delivery scope.
